room_rent.note: Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing Expenses up to 1% of Sum Insured per day

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges up to 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: 20% co-payment applies to every claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern treatments capped at 50% of Sum Insured

ped_waiting.note: 36 months for all PEDs except pre-existing disability (24 months) and HIV/AIDS (30-day initial wait only)

specific_disease_waiting.note: 19 listed conditions including hernia, cataract, hydrocele, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; indicative list of procedures provided in Annexure III

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured is explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursed up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of Sum Insured as inpatient or day care

consumables.note: Consumables/non-medical items listed in Annexure II are explicitly excluded

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, claims cannot be contested except for fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/non-monthly modes; 15 days for monthly instalment mode

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies with term of one year or more

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, no domiciliary, no organ donor, no maternity, no OPD, no STDs, no stem cell storage, no alternative therapies (acupuncture etc.)

optional_riders.display: Co-payment waiver (pay extra premium to remove 20% co-pay)
